invariants.description: exact solution with constant BCs: u(t) = u_ss + (u(0) - u_ss) e^(-t/RC), u_ss = u_in - R v_out, u(0) = u_0 + (q_init - q_0)/C
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(u - ((u_in - R*v_out) + ((u_0 + (q_init - q_0)/C) - (u_in - R*v_out))*np.exp(-t/(R*C))))) <= 1e-6*(np.max(np.abs(u)) + 1e-3) + 1e-4*abs(u_in - R*v_out - (u_0 + (q_init - q_0)/C))

invariants.description: Ohm law v = (u_in - u)/R and pressure-volume law u = u_0 + (q - q_0)/C
invariants.expr: np.allclose(v*R, u_in - u, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-9*abs(u_in)) & np.allclose(u, u_0 + (q - q_0)/C, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-9*np.max(np.abs(u)))

invariants.description: volume balance: q(t) - q_init = integral of (inflow - outflow)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(q - q_init - np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*((v - v_out)[1:] + (v - v_out)[:-1])*np.diff(t))]))) <= (2e-3 + ((t[1] - t[0])/(R*C))**2/3)*np.max(np.abs(q - q_init)) + 1e-6*abs(q_init)

invariants.description: volume stays positive (q > 0) at the run point (not across the sweep: a constant forced outflow can legitimately drain the compartment below zero)

bc_sweep.rationale: Pressures 0.5-1.5x a 12 kPa (90 mmHg) mean plus the R x flow drop, flows 0-3x a 5 L/min cardiac output, initial volume from unstressed to unstressed + 2 C x 12 kPa, u_0 0-6 kPa; R, C, q_0 at 0.5-2x. The exact solution is checked at every point.

baseline.reason: generic linear RC building block with no specific anatomical counterpart; verified against its exact solution. Validation belongs to a network built from it.

calibrate.note: not_applicable: generic building block; see baseline
